title: 第4章 晶核！源能！
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始

第(1/3)页

眼前的男人，的确很像罗兰认知中的丧尸。

“不过，之前在聚集地的时候，没有听说过有这种碎片世界存在。”

“看来，这是一个新的碎片世界。”

念头闪过，罗兰看着嘶吼着逼近自己的丧尸，快速拔刀，警惕地盯着这头丧尸。

如果他没有记错的话，这些丧尸身上都有着病毒，而且这种丧尸病毒感染力非常强，正常人如果接触到了丧尸病毒，要不了半小时，就会变成丧尸！

“一旦被抓伤、咬到、亦或者被丧尸的血液进入眼睛......都有可能变成丧尸！”

罗兰双手持刀，看着逼近过来的丧尸，直接就是一记横斩！

对于没有武器的普通人来说，想要无伤击杀丧尸十分困难，但是对于刀法等于达到2级，而且身体素质远在常人之上的罗兰来说，想要无伤击杀丧尸，并不困难！

一道深可见骨的伤口出现在了丧尸膝盖处。

控制身体运动的肌肉被切断，哪怕是丧尸，此刻也无法命令自己的膝盖弯曲伸直。

趁着丧尸的平衡被自己打破，罗兰连续几刀再度斩出，刀刃破空，发出呼呼风声！

而他每一次攻击的重点，都是丧尸膝盖附近的肌肉。

几刀下去，丧尸已经不能站立，只能趴在地上朝着罗兰伸出双手胡乱撕扯，口中嘶吼不断。

不过，躺在地上不能移动的丧尸，对于罗兰来说，根本不会造成任何威胁。

下一刻，罗兰将刀身高高举起，目光瞄准丧尸的身体。

“不能攻击气管和动脉，不然的话，到时候血喷出来，难免会弄到身上。”

想到这里，罗兰双手一动，翻转刀身，用刀背对准了丧尸。

随即，差一点就能碰到天花板的长刀猛地狠狠下劈！

一声闷响从丧尸脖子处传来，原本还在不断动弹的丧尸，此刻身体猛地一颤，随即便没有了任何动静。

罗兰重新举刀，再次下劈。

一连几次，直到他确认这头丧尸已经死的不能再死了，这才停下了手。

“呼！”

罗兰持刀而立，看着脚下的丧尸，长长出了一口气，随即擦了擦微微冒汗的额头。

虽然体质属性已经到了常人极限，但是连续将近十刀的全力斩击，依旧让罗兰额头见汗。

罗兰知道，就算是常人极限的体质，依旧是常人，而不是超凡！

“这头丧尸，似乎死了挺长一段时间？”

罗兰仔细打量着丧尸，然而，还没等他看出什么，门外就猛地传来了一阵阵的嘶吼声和撞门声！

“不好！”

罗兰神色一凝，随即放好长刀，目光快速扫过客厅，随即便拉动茶几，将其放在了大门后面。

放好茶几后，罗兰又将一部分沙发挪了过去。

确定门外的丧尸基本不可能进来之后，罗兰这才松了一口气。

“这些丧尸，对声音、光线还有活人气味十分敏感。”

“虽然我刚刚击杀这头丧尸的时候动静很小，但是我身上的气味，已经被其他丧尸感知到了。”

Page (1/3)

The man in front of him indeed looked like the zombie Roland knew.

"However, when I was at the gathering place before, I had never heard of the existence of such a fragmented world."

"It seems that this is a new fragmented world."

Thoughts flashed across his mind, Roland looked at the roaring zombie approaching him, quickly drew his knife, and stared at the zombie warily.

If he remembered correctly, these zombies all have viruses, and this zombie virus is very contagious. If a normal person is exposed to the zombie virus, he will turn into a zombie in less than half an hour!

"Once you are scratched, bitten, or have zombie blood enter your eyes... you may turn into a zombie!"

Roland held the knife in both hands, looked at the approaching zombies, and made a direct slash!

For ordinary people without weapons, it is very difficult to kill zombies without injury, but for Roland, whose sword skills are equal to level 2 and whose physical fitness is far above ordinary people, it is not difficult to kill zombies without injury!

A deep wound with bone visible appeared on the zombie's knee.

The muscles that control body movement have been severed, and even a zombie cannot order its knees to bend or straighten at this moment.

Taking advantage of the zombie's balance being broken by himself, Roland slashed out several times in succession, the blade pierced the air and made a whirring sound!

The focus of each of his attacks is the muscles near the zombie's knees.

After several blows, the zombie could no longer stand. He could only lie on the ground and stretched out his hands towards Roland to tear at Roland while shouting continuously.

However, the zombies lying on the ground and unable to move did not pose any threat to Roland at all.

The next moment, Roland raised the knife high and aimed at the zombie's body.

"You can't attack the trachea and arteries, otherwise, when the blood spurts out, it will inevitably get on your body."

Thinking of this, Roland moved his hands, turned the blade over, and pointed the back of the blade at the zombies.

Immediately, the long knife that almost touched the ceiling slashed hard!

A muffled sound came from the zombie's neck. The zombie, which was still moving, suddenly trembled, and then there was no movement at all.

Roland raised the knife again and struck again.

Several times in a row, he stopped until he was sure that the zombie was dead.

"Phew!"

Roland stood with a knife in hand, looked at the zombies at his feet, took a long breath, and then wiped his slightly sweating forehead.

Although his physical attributes had reached the limit of ordinary people, nearly ten consecutive full-force slashes still made Roland sweat on his forehead.

Roland knew that even if his physique was at the limit of ordinary people, he would still be an ordinary person, not extraordinary!

"This zombie seems to have been dead for a long time?"

Roland looked at the zombies carefully. However, before he could see anything, there were bursts of roars and knocks on the door!

"Not good!"

Roland's expression condensed, then he put down the long knife, glanced quickly across the living room, then pulled the coffee table and placed it behind the door.

After placing the coffee table, Roland moved part of the sofa over.

After confirming that it was almost impossible for the zombies outside the door to come in, Roland breathed a sigh of relief.

"These zombies are very sensitive to sound, light and the smell of living people."

"Although there was very little movement when I just killed this zombie, the smell on my body has already been sensed by other zombies."
